block.wait.model.title: Wait
block.wait.model.description: Delay each message by a duration or until a date before passing it on.
block.wait.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.wait.listener_unavailable: The wait listener is unavailable; nothing was queued. Stop and Run again.
block.wait.listener_refused: The wait listener refused the message (stopped or full); it was not queued.
block.wait.one_shot_limit: One Shot waits at most {max} s; this message would wait {delay} s. Use Active Runtime for longer waits.
block.wait.usage_commands: On command_in, {"action":"flush"} releases every pending message now and {"action":"cancel"} drops them.
block.wait.usage_one_shot: Active Runtime keeps messages waiting without blocking the graph. One Shot waits inside the activation, at most 240 s.
block.wait.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.wait.help_mode: duration waits the same number of seconds for every message. until releases at an ISO 8601 instant.
block.wait.help_seconds: Delay from the arrival of each message, from 0.1 to 86400 seconds (24 hours).
block.wait.help_until: ISO 8601 instant with an offset or Z, for example 2026-10-10T14:30:00Z. A past instant releases at once.
block.wait.help_until_path: Optional JSON Pointer read in each JSON message, for example /release_at. When set, it replaces until.
block.wait.help_report_cancelled: Send messages dropped by cancel, refused at admission or stopped in One Shot to the cancelled output, with the reason.
block.wait.help_max_pending: Maximum number of messages waiting at once. Further messages are refused and reported.
block.wait.help_max_message_bytes: Maximum size of one message in UTF-8 bytes. Larger messages are refused and reported without their content.
block.wait.help_max_pending_bytes: Maximum total size of the waiting messages, in bytes. It bounds the memory used by this node.
